race.comment: BRAZEN WARRIOR (1) has been well supported at his first two runs back from a spell but hasn't quite delivered yet, with a heavy track being against him last time out. However, he should be nearing peak fitness, and he is expected to finish a lot closer here. On top. FILIGREE SHADOW (7) has also attracted market attention since returning and produced an improved effort at Ballarat Synthetic last start when finishing fourth. She looks ready to take another step forward and shapes as a leading contender. VIPERSTRIKE (4) showed promise when placing third on debut at Kilmore before failing to fire at Moe and with a nice jump-out win since then, he should be hard to hold out. SATTVA (10) was solid when runner-up at Bairnsdale just over 6 weeks ago, and will strip fitter, making her a genuine each-way threat. KING CAMELOT (2) resumes off a recent jump-out victory, and he can add interest fresh.
